items.q: There was a girl that worked at the candy and cigarette counter in the Savoy named Margie who was very beautiful and I used to talk to her sometimes when I was not on the bandstand.

ctx.x: I would sleep all afternoon and get up in time to go and get something to eat and then get to the Savoy for another night which was always a pleasure.

There was a girl that worked at the candy and cigarette counter in the Savoy named Margie who was very beautiful and I used to talk to her sometimes when I was not on the bandstand. I never flirted with her or tried to make her my girl friend and she had no eyes for me in that sense. Rex saw me talking to her quite often, and as he was bashful, he asked me to introduce her to him which I did one Sunday when another orchestra was playing the supper hours.. I hated to see the Horace Henderson group leave the place at the end of February because I had enjoyed the competition between the two orchestras and so had they. It had been a new experience for me and it was different from the way we had competed with the Buffalodians because they were at one end of the hall and we were at the other end.
